source_limits.source: Public ABN Lookup bulk extract linked by the official ABN Lookup page and data.gov.au dataset
source_limits.refresh: Manual requests only during this decision; no new six-hour polling or automatic register download timer is authorised merely by this document
fields_retained_in_analytical_projection: ABN status and its effective date
entity type and documented derived entity class
business and trading names with source type, including retained OTN solely for faithful source comparison rather than classification
source member, content/publication identity and observation timestamps
source_limits.raw_incidental_fields: The finite raw archive can also contain corporate identifier, DGR and other legitimate public fields. Validate the actual source schema but do not silently add those unused values to promoted profiles or downstream outputs.
prohibited_inferences: registration date is incorporation or trading start
a first baseline record is a newly registered business
GST or ABN status proves revenue, active trading, fit or contact permission
a name match proves the actual trade
missing or unfamiliar source values mean active
source_limits.contacts_from_bulk: No phone, email, street address or private government data is sought or inferred from this public field set

personal_information_and_necessity.acknowledgement: Legal and business names, ABNs and state/postcode can identify sole traders or other individuals. Public availability and the copyright licence are not consent or a finding that all privacy obligations are satisfied.
personal_information_and_necessity.whole_register_necessity: A complete coherent source is needed to validate the publication and establish a correct future whole-set comparison; loading only apparent target-name matches would conceal cancellations, disappearances and name changes. Retain the full raw/analytical input only for its bounded validation/comparison purpose.
personal_information_and_necessity.minimisation: Expose only bounded authenticated validation views and private review samples. Do not materialise every baseline business as a lead or publish the register. Internal target sampling retains the approved QLD/NSW2450-2490 direction; no new geography or trade taxonomy is approved.

matching_review.sampling: Start with four genuine classified examples for each of the first ten rules and three for each remaining rule; stratify BN/MAIN/TRD, target geography and overlap cases. Expand sparse/ambiguous strata rather than invent an observation. Add negative/unclassified checks separately.
matching_review.ground_truth: An attributable reviewer independently verifies actual trade using genuine permitted evidence, records source/observed date and marks match, false positive or unresolved. A rule output, guessed name meaning or synthetic fixture is not independent truth. Unresolved records do not count as passing reviews.
matching_review.threshold: More than10percent false positives blocks the affected rule pending review. Report per-rule and overall denominators; do not dilute a failing rule in an overall average.
matching_review.receipt_contract: Bind private review rows and computed aggregate result to the coherent source snapshot, actual parser/mapping, exact ordered rule IDs and LF rule hash, reviewer/date, evidence references and regression-suite digest. Preserve zero/pending until actual review; setting precision_sample_count=100 alone is insufficient.
matching_review.validation_only_phase: Shadow classification may prepare a private accuracy sample with clearly labelled unapproved predictions. It must not create eligible leads, enrich businesses, select worklist rows or disclose ABR-derived records to vendors.
matching_review.qualification_admission: Operational ABR classification/qualification requires actual R9 review and a separate exact-release admission of that phase. This collection-purpose and G6 sequencing decision does not certify the100-record result or individual business eligibility.
